title: A strict prefix of the seed's 200 bytes, cut mid-object
notes: source: WV-PORT-API-STALL-SUSPENDED-01, mutation: the seed's first 120 bytes (floor(0.6 * 200), offset 120 of 200), ending right after the `cellRef` object closes and before `portName` begins. normative ([WIR1-I07]'s truncation clause): observed kotlinx.serialization.SerializationException (JsonDecodingException) "Expected end of the object '}', but had 'EOF' instead at path: $" — the JVM decoder DOES distinguish this from other malformed JSON by its own message, so no `malformed` fallback was needed here (SCHEMA.md's `truncated` classifies exactly). Dead-letter accounting on the receiving side is covered by wire/src/test/kotlin/civictech/wire/WsIngressDecodeFailureTest.kt, not retested here.
